description: This file is a PHP source file implementing server-side logic for saving webmail messages into the CRM system. It handles email retrieval, parsing, attachment management, and creating related database entries such as Contacts and Documents, indicating it is part of the webmail integration module.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: A class representing email message details, loaded with email content and metadata.

classes.name: Webmails
classes.description: A class that manages email retrieval and parsing from a mailbox.

classes.name: MailBox
classes.description: A class for interacting with mailbox folders and retrieving messages.

classes.name: Documents
classes.description: A class representing document attachments and related metadata.

methods.name: add_attachment_to_contact
methods.description: Function to add email attachments to a contact record, also creating associated Document entries.

methods.name: view_part_detail
methods.description: Helper function to fetch and decode parts of an email message.
